    What you are watching

    Actual browser controls and calculated outputs. All 47 chapters were captured on 14 October 2026, separately in English and Spanish. Tutorial highlights and chapter titles are added in editing; computation waits are shortened and built-in demos are held for explanation. Narration is synthetic, in English and Spanish. Available interface translations follow the selected language; published names and scientific notation retain their source conventions.

    Each chapter demonstrates representative controls and explains how to read the result. It is not an exhaustive enumeration of every possible input. Model assumptions and experimental scope remain part of the explanation.
